transaction: caller-owned SQLite writer transaction, no commit or rollback
issuer: current authorized company with legal name, registration, country and address
customer: current confirmed customer and active party profile with matching row version
address: exactly one selected nonempty buyer or billing address
contact: confirmed contact belonging to customer, exact id and row version in contact_refs
terms: profile trade and payment term references must exactly match quotation references
proof: calculation.trade_party_binding contains resolved values, profile hashes and binding hash
history: old records remain readable; missing or changed proof cannot authorize new formalization; committed replay remains unchanged
limitations: contact profile contacts are not supported
other address roles are not supported
term override and negotiation are not supported
no complete quotation runtime, T04, production admission or V1.0 claim
